SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

3. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   D. Treat School administration as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   B. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   C. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

7. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   C. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   B. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   C. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   B. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.

12. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.
   B. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.

13. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   C. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   C. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

15. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.

16. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   B. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
